name: GMAI-MMBench
intro: GMAI-MMBench是一个全面的通用医疗AI基准，旨在评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在各种医疗应用中的有效性。该基准解决了现有基准在临床相关性、评估不完整性和交互式LVLMs指导不足等方面的局限性。它由284个数据集构建，涵盖38种医学图像模态、18项临床相关任务、18个科室和4种感知粒度，采用视觉问答（VQA）形式。
build_method: 多源医疗数据整合, 标签标准化, 人工验证
metric: 单选准确率, 多选命中率与召回率
eval_feature: 零样本, 可定制词汇树切片, 隐藏测试答案
build_method_en: Multi-source Medical Data Integration, Label Standardization, Human Validation
eval_feature_en: Zero-shot, Custom Lexical-tree Slices, Hidden Test Answers
intro_en: GMAI-MMBench is a comprehensive general medical AI benchmark designed to evaluate the effectiveness of large vision-language models (LVLMs) across various medical applications. It addresses limitations of existing benchmarks in clinical relevance, incomplete evaluation, and insufficient guidance for interactive LVLMs. The benchmark is built from 284 datasets, covering 38 medical image modalities, 18 clinically relevant tasks, 18 departments, and 4 levels of perceptual granularity, using a visual question answering (VQA) format.
scale_en: 25,831 VQA pairs (4,550 validation; 21,281 test) from 284 datasets

drawio_review_note: Verified against arXiv:2408.03361v7, the official repository at d8a6a326daf291a5e2ad702f9925cff0429002ee, OpenGVLab/GMAI-MMBench at a8c7450a66400adda3f8e93d9cdc7b2fd541a295, and VLMEvalKit at 7055d3010c38ccb5dcae1bc9535ca19c7fe5d79f. Construction retains 268 public and 16 ethically approved hospital datasets; converts 2D/3D inputs to 2D RGB under the SA-Med2D-20M protocol; normalizes labels with MeSH; and vote-merges three labelers into 38 modalities, 18 clinical VQA tasks, 18 departments, and four granularities. For each modality-task-granularity combination, ten labels seed ten GPT-4o candidate questions each; global and local views use different option-pool rules. Manual checks require all three cues and image dependence, remove wrong answers or poor targets/images, then keep at most 30 diverse cases per answer. The paper release is 25,831 pairs: 4,550 validation and 21,281 hidden-key test. Its zero-shot single- and multi-select prompts use option letters; unclear output falls back to ChatGPT-3.5-turbo-0613 and extraction failure is wrong. Single ACC is correct/questions; multi ACC and recall are match/predicted and match/ground-truth. In the pinned VLMEvalKit revision, GMAIMMBenchDataset does not override build_prompt: it inherits ImageMCQDataset and formats an optional Hint, Question, Options with lettered choices, followed exactly by “Please select the correct answer from the options above.” The direct-letter suffix “Answer with the option's letter from the given choices directly.” belongs to the adjacent MUIRDataset class and must not be attributed to GMAI-MMBench. GMAI evaluation defaults to exact_matching with letter/text inference and an optional judge, and the pinned class has no paper-equivalent multi-select parser; these implementation boundaries are drawn separately.
